claims.text: GEPAN's June 1978 five-volume report to its scientific council studied eleven high-credibility, high-strangeness cases; 'only one proved to have a conventional explanation'. 'In 10 of the 11 cases, the conclusion was that the witnesses had witnessed a material phenomenon that could not be explained as a natural phenomenon or a human device', and the report concluded that behind the phenomenon there is a 'flying machine. . . whose modes of sustenance and propulsion are beyond our knowledge'.
